method: Real Chrome WebGL2 + official pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.parseAsync(original GLB ArrayBuffer). Independent browser raw-accessor decoder verifies loaded P/N/UV/index bytes and representation; authored normals are never recomputed. Embedded linear PBR factors and source face culling retained. URDF XML assembled with origin RzRyRx, joint axis/limits/mimic, visual origin and scale. JS FK checked against independent Python/Numpy link matrices; GLB scene node hierarchy remains under each visual. Neutral RoomEnvironment/PMREM image-based illumination plus white directional lights.
scope_notes: Representative12 robot assemblies, not the entire catalog.
Images are visual acceptance evidence; no cross-engine pixel-equivalence or exact measured factory paint claim.
Original assets are copied byte-exact to temporary HTTP snapshots; cache keys include every URDF/GLB source SHA and fixture version.
URDF colors do not overwrite embedded GLB materials.
Native single-sided culling is preserved. Geometry/source-normal data preservation is separate from model-specific visual review.

reproduce.cache: Automatically snapshots current source, detects source SHA/fixture/pose changes, reloads and re-renders affected models. --force ignores valid screenshot cache.
